# evroc_placement_group (Resource)

Manages an evroc placement group for VM placement control.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the placement group.
- `strategy` (String) Placement strategy: 'spread' or 'cluster'.

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project this resource belongs to. Defaults to the provider project.
- `region` (String) Region where the placement group will be created.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `user_labels` (Map of String) User-defined labels (key/value pairs) for organizing and selecting resources.
- `zone` (String) Zone for the placement group (a, b, or c).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the placement group was created.
- `fqid` (String) Fully qualified resource ID (FQID). Use this to reference this resource from other resources.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `pg_id` (String) Unique identifier of the placement group.
- `system_labels` (Map of String) System-managed labels automatically set by evroc (read-only).
